blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – As many as 83 Olive Ridley (Lepidochelys olivacea) sea turtle hatchlings, locally known as “pawikan,” were released into Tayabas Bay off Sariaya, Quezon, on Wednesday, marking the first batch released this nesting season. The hatchlings were released at 4:30 p.m. along the shoreline of Barangay Bignay 2, drawing cheers from fishermen and their families, local and barangay officials, and tourists who witnessed the event. “Another batch of 100 Olive Ridley hatchlings is scheduled for release on Nov. 27,” Edwin Frias, a deputized “bantay dagat (fish warden) member, told the Inquirer in an online interview.
